disabledDescription: Disabled; user logs will not be hidden automatically
enabledDescription: Enabled; expired entries are hidden when logs are viewed
notice: This only hides expired logs from the user view. Records are not physically deleted and remain available to administrators.
retentionHint: From 1 to 3650 days. Expired entries are hidden the next time the user views their logs.

validation.retentionDays: Retention days must be an integer from 1 to 3650
